race.comment: BAZAACTLY (6) was very impressive on debut when settling out the back, closing to finish 1.4L off the winner in a strong display. A better draw and a rise in trip appear big ticks for him with CJP remaining in the saddle. Looks to have plenty of ability and can score his maiden win this time around. WIN FOR BUSTER (1) has been sound on his return to racing and now gets Pike in the saddle third-up and out in trip. He's only been tested at this distance once where he jumped a $1.50 favourite and disappointed at the end of the campaign. Wouldn't surprise to see him get back to his best. CAPE CHURCHILL (13) is racing well and showing plenty of talent early in his career. Will need a touch of luck from the draw, but it wouldn't surprise to see her land the knockout blow. OCEAN REEF (5) can improve third-up into his debut campaign. OLAF THE SNOWMAN (3) is ticking along nicely and is not to be discounted from the inside draw.
